detail.longDescription: Oh, the humanity! 🤖 Why is machine gibberish giving humans headaches? Three brave souls tackle the enigma of AI's linguistic labyrinth, only to conclude that robots speak a dialect of nonsensical jargon. Spoiler alert: it's hard to understand because it's # nonsense . 🤦‍♂️ https:// arxiv.org/abs/2610.29162 # AI # Linguistics # MachineLearning # TechHumor # HumanExperience # HackerNews # ngated
